overview.description: PT Bumi Resources Tbk is a holding company primarily engaged in thermal coal exploration and extraction through subsidiaries including Kaltim Prima Coal and Arutmin.

news.title: Bumi Resources Faces Lower Selling Price and Royalty Burdens
news.summary: Bumi Resources experienced margin compression due to lower thermal coal realization prices and high government non-tax revenue obligations.

news.title: BUMI Studies Coal Downstreaming and Gasification Feasibility
news.summary: BUMI continues feasibility studies for coal gasification to methanol, without committing committed capex as debt restructuring covenants restrict major capital outlays.
